name: labs/norlovs__ot2-robotics-cv-control
title: OT-2 pipetting-robot digital twin (OT2Env)
intro: OT-2 pipetting-robot digital twin (OT2Env), adapted from norlovs/ot2-robotics-cv-control. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
